lines: Blocked Hours locks the apps on a
schedule I set once.
At 9am there is no decision left
to make.
Focus sessions have a strict mode
that cannot be ended early.
The session decides, not my mood
at minute twelve.
The whole day gets planned in 30
seconds the night before.
Habits, tasks and events land on
one timeline.
Breaks come out of a budget, not
out of nowhere.
85 minutes for the day, and the
app keeps count.
Tasks sit in projects with priority
flags, and urgent ones show a count
on the project itself.
Nothing loose, nothing forgotten.
The countdown runs on the lock
screen and in the Dynamic Island.
I can end a break without opening
the app.
A habit locks in at 66 days, the
number the research actually uses.
The streak is the whole point.
Weekly recaps show where the hours
went, focus time against habit time.
It is uncomfortable and useful.
Blocked windows show as bands on
the day timeline.
I can see the locked hours before
I plan anything into them.
Apple's limits have an ignore
button. This does not.
The block holds until the block
ends.
